issues: Train/test split is not per‑bin stratified and does not use the required sample size; ranking omits AIC and BIC; missing matplotlib causes script to crash instead of skipping plotting.
recommendation: Fix the split logic to sample int(0.2 * min(bin_counts)) per bin and stratify by final_label; include AIC and BIC in the ranking calculation; wrap matplotlib import in try/except or move it inside the plotting block so the script continues when the library is absent.
